title: A Real-Time Autonomous Gravity Measurement Method for Underwater Gravity-Aided Navigation
authors: W. Ai; S. Zhong; Y. Leng; S. Wang
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
